summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026, announcing the dispatch of a Postal Ballot Notice to shareholders seeking approval for the re-appointment of an independent director and the appointment of another independent director, alongside a buyback of equity shares. The buyback is a capital return event but the filing is a routine disclosure of a shareholder vote on corporate governance matters and a share buyback proposal. No specific terms for the buyback (price, size, timeline) are stated in this excerpt. The filing does not constitute a special situation as it is merely a notice of a postal ballot for routine shareholder approvals. What to watch: further details on the buyback terms once the resolution is passed.
